title: Workforce capacity planning
description: Translate planned work into team skill and capacity decisions using documented assumptions.

sources.title: U.S. Office of Personnel Management, Workforce Planning Model

rules.instruction: Identify the capabilities needed for the planned work, then estimate team capacity and gaps by role and period. Use aggregated workforce data for planning.
rules.verification: Have team leads verify the demand and availability assumptions and identify which gaps would remain if the plan changed.

rules.instruction: For each material gap, compare actions such as training, redistribution or hiring. Record who owns the chosen action and when the capacity estimate will be revisited.
rules.verification: Check that the option comparison shows time to close the gap and operational trade-offs. Review the estimate at the agreed decision date.
